name: Autosomal Recessive Axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Due to Copper Metabolism Defect
aliases: AR Axonal CMT with Copper Metabolism Defect

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Autosomal Recessive Axonal CMT with Copper Metabolism Defect

criteria.description: Presence of progressive distal muscle weakness and atrophy predominantly affecting lower limbs
Nerve conduction studies showing axonal neuropathy with reduced compound muscle action potentials
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in genes involved in copper metabolism (e.g., ATP7A, ATP7B)
Laboratory evidence of abnormal copper metabolism such as altered serum ceruloplasmin or copper levels
Consanguinity or family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical neuropathy, electrophysiological evidence of axonal neuropathy, and confirmation of biallelic pathogenic variants in copper metabolism-related genes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of axonal neuropathy and copper metabolism disorders such as Wilson disease.

common.symptomName: Impaired vibration sensation in the lower limbs

laboratory: Abnormal serum ceruloplasmin and copper levels
Elevated urinary copper excretion in some cases
imaging: MRI may show mild cerebellar atrophy in advanced cases
Nerve ultrasound showing reduced nerve cross-sectional area
other: Electrophysiological studies demonstrating axonal neuropathy with reduced compound muscle action potentials and preserved conduction velocities

distinguishingFeatures: Different genetic mutations (ATP7B) with autosomal recessive inheritance
Demyelinating vs axonal neuropathy distinction on electrophysiology

redFlags: Rapid progression of distal weakness and sensory loss
Early onset of severe motor disability
Signs of systemic copper metabolism dysfunction (e.g., liver abnormalities)
references: Orphanet: Autosomal recessive axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease due to copper metabolism defect, ORPHA:521411
Harding AE. Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease: clinical and genetic aspects. J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry. 1982
Kaler SG. ATP7A-related copper transport diseases—emerging concepts and future trends. Nat Rev Neurol. 2011
